Repo-To-Skill：将 GitHub 存储库提炼为 AI4AI 技能Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills

Jianlyu Chen1,2†‡    Yuyang Hu1,3†‡    Hongjin Qian1†    Jiawei Liu2†    Wenqing Wei1,2†‡    Xiaolong Chen2
Defu Lian2∗    Zhicheng Dou3∗    Chaozhuo Li1    Qiwei Ye1    Zheng Liu1,4∗ Affiliation: 1Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, 2University of Science and Technology of China,
3Renmin University of China, 4Hong Kong Polytechnic University
摘要Abstract

自主代理开始开展端到端的机器学习 (ML) 研究。这些代理将模型主干与用于规划、执行、存储和验证的工具相结合，但这种架构仍然将特定领域的专业知识保留在代理之外。我们称此为缺失层Autonomous agents are beginning to carry out machine-learning (ML) research end to end. These agents combine a model backbone with a harness for planning, execution, memory, and verification, but this architecture still leaves domain-specific know-how outside the agent. We call this missing layer操作知识operational knowledge，将了解方法与使其发挥作用分开的专业知识。该领域并不缺乏这种知识。它出现在存储库和论文中，但以为人类读者编写的形式出现，并且太大而无法在任务期间加载。一旦蒸馏成紧凑型并经过验证, the know-how that separates knowing a method from making it work. That knowledge is not absent from the field. It appears in repositories and papers, but in forms written for human readers and too large to load during a task. Once distilled into compact, verified技能skills，这些知识可以跨任务重用，而不是在每次运行期间重新发现。, this knowledge can be reused across tasks rather than rediscovered during each run.

我们呈现We present迪斯科DisCo，一个以技能为动力的研究代理，可以创造技能并在研究过程中使用它们。它的提炼以两种互补的形式进行：与任务无关，将领域广泛使用的存储库压缩为可重用的技能；以及面向任务，产生具体任务所需的技能。前者应用于整个开放生态系统，产生, a skill-powered research agent that creates skills and uses them during research. Its distillation runs in two complementary forms: task-agnostic, condensing the field’s widely used repositories into reusable skills, and task-oriented, producing the skills a concrete task calls for. The former, applied across the open ecosystem, yields theAREX-技能AREX-Skill图书馆Library，拥有从 1,000 个广泛使用的 ML 存储库中提取的 5,000 多种经过验证的技能，并分为 20 个领域和 178 个功能系列。在 GPT-5.5 主干、研究工具和下游执行预算保持固定的情况下，具备技能的研究代理在以下方面的得分高出 134.3%：, with 5,000+ verified skills distilled from 1,000 widely used ML repositories and organized into 20 areas and 178 capability families. With the GPT-5.5 backbone, research harness, and downstream execution budget held fixed, the skill-equipped research agent scores 134.3% higher onMLE 工作台MLE-bench，上涨 34.4%, 34.4% higher on纸凳PaperBench，上涨 9.2%, 9.2% higher on前沿CSFrontierCS，上涨 14.0%, and 14.0% higher on通行网PassNet与没有技能的相同代理人相比。这些收益来自于在固定设置下添加精炼的操作上下文。than the same agent without skills. These gains come from adding distilled operating context under that fixed setup.

1 简介Introduction

自主代理开始执行机器学习 (ML) 研究流程的大部分，从实施方法到运行实验和比较结果Autonomous agents are beginning to execute larger parts of the machine-learning (ML) research pipeline, from implementing methods to running experiments and comparing results(Lu et al., 2024; Yamada et al., 2025; Schmidgall et al., 2025)。机器学习研究是一个天然的测试平台，因为它的大部分实践都是在软件中展开的，而编码代理已被证明是最有能力的. ML research is a natural testbed because much of its practice unfolds in software, where coding agents have proved most capable(Jin et al., 2026; Dong et al., 2026).

与任何代理系统一样，这些研究代理依赖于两个模块：Like any agentic system, these research agents rest on two modules: a模型model提供理解、推理、计划和执行，以及that supplies understanding, reasoning, planning, and execution, and a马具harness它提供编排、内存、验证和迭代细化。模型随着前沿世代改进，线束通过工程实践改进that supplies orchestration, memory, verification, and iterative refinement. The model improves with frontier generations, and the harness improves through engineering practice(Karpathy, 2026)。然而，机器学习研究是专业知识密集型的，这意味着成功取决于了解使用哪些方法和工具、何时使用它们以及如何正确使用它们。这两个组件都不具备这种专业知识。该模型的先验广泛但固定，而线束控制过程但不提供领域内容。我们称缺失层为. ML research, however, is expertise-intensive, which means success depends on knowing which methods and tools to use, when to use them, and how to use them correctly. Neither component carries this expertise. The model’s prior is broad but fixed, while the harness controls procedure but does not supply domain content. We call the missing layer操作知识operational knowledge. 操作知识是了解方法与使其发挥作用的区别：将领域的方法和工具与手头的任务结合起来的专业知识。Operational knowledge is what separates knowing a method from making it work: the expertise that binds the field’s methods and tools to the task at hand.在机器学习研究中，范围从选择适当的方法和实验设置到正确使用包 API、配置训练管道以及处理常见的实施和评估陷阱。这些知识大量存在，分散在存储库和论文中，但没有专门针对任何任务进行组织。In ML research, it ranges from choosing appropriate methods and experimental settings to using package APIs correctly, configuring training pipelines, and handling common implementation and evaluation pitfalls. This knowledge exists in abundance, scattered through repositories and papers yet organized for no task in particular.

如果没有操作知识，代理就会损失任务中的预算，并且无法在任务中重用其推断的内容。在任务中，它必须通过反复试验来推断包行为，只有在预算花费在错误配置的运行上之后，错误才会出现。在任务中，这些发现不会保留为可重用上下文。知识必须以代理可以命令的形式到达代理：可发现、可加载且可供使用。Without operational knowledge, an agent loses budget within a task and fails to reuse what it infers across tasks. Within a task, it must infer package behavior through trial and error, and mistakes surface only after budgets have been spent on misconfigured runs. Across tasks, those discoveries are not retained as reusable context. The knowledge must reach the agent in a form it can command: discoverable, loadable, and ready to use.技能Skills提供此表格offer this form(Anthropic, 2025b)。一项技能包含一项专业知识。一个. A skill packages one piece of know-how. A技能.mdSKILL.md文件说明了该技能的用途、何时应用以及如何进行。参考文档带有证据，脚本自动执行日常操作。由于技能以摘要开头，并且仅根据需要展开，因此代理可以拥有数千种技能，但只读取任务所需的少数技能，从而允许知识层扩展而不会拥挤上下文。安全带仍然控制着智能体如何进行研究，而技能则决定了研究开始时它知道什么。图file states what the skill is for, when it applies, and how to proceed. Reference documents carry evidence, and scripts automate routine actions. Because a skill opens with a summary and unfolds only on demand, an agent can hold thousands of skills yet read just the few a task needs, allowing the knowledge layer to scale without crowding the context. The harness still governs how the agent researches, while skills determine what it knows when research begins. Figure1(a) 说明了这个缺失的层面：除了模型和工具之外，技能还将无指导的试验和错误转变为有指导的执行。(a) illustrates this missing layer: beyond the model and harness, skills turn unguided trial and error into guided execution.

技能表示涉及如何使用操作知识，但不涉及如何获得技能。相关源材料已经存在于存储库和论文中，但它是为人类读者编写的，并且太大而无法在任务期间加载。我们将这些材料提炼成适合代理背景预算的紧凑、可操作且经过验证的技能。困难在于源代码随着每次版本的发布而变化，遗漏了许多实际的陷阱，并且在没有使其工作所需的专业知识的情况下陈述了方法。方法论问题是从声明性来源自动大规模地产生操作知识。The skill representation addresses how operational knowledge is consumed, but not how the skills are obtained. The relevant source material already exists in repositories and papers, but it is written for human readers and is too large to load during a task. We distill this material into compact, operational, and verified skills that fit the agent’s context budget. The difficulty lies in the sources, which drift with every release, omit many practical pitfalls, and state methods without the know-how needed to make them work. The methodological problem is to produce operational knowledge automatically and at scale from declarative sources.

我们应对这一挑战We meet this challenge with迪斯科DisCo，一个以技能为动力的研究代理，既创造技能又用它们进行研究。, a skill-powered research agent that both creates skills and researches with them.迪斯科DisCo保持模型和工具不变，并通过两种互补形式的技能蒸馏来构建操作知识层。leaves the model and the harness unchanged and builds the operational-knowledge layer through skill distillation in two complementary forms.与任务无关的蒸馏Task-agnostic distillation提前工作，将该领域广泛使用的存储库和日常工具浓缩为任何研究任务都可以利用的可重用技能。works ahead of time, condensing the field’s widely used repositories and everyday tools into reusable skills that any research task can draw on.面向任务的蒸馏Task-oriented distillation按需工作。给定一个具体的任务，works on demand. Given a concrete task,迪斯科DisCo探索任务涉及的知识并产生任务所需的技能。在任何一种形式下，未经验证，任何技能都不会进入该层。每个候选人都会被检查，尽可能修复，并记录任何剩余的差距。explores the knowledge the task touches and produces the skills it calls for. Under either form, no skill enters the layer without verification. Each candidate is checked, repaired where possible, and recorded with any remaining gaps.

与任务无关的蒸馏，在开放的生态系统中运行，产生Task-agnostic distillation, run across the open ecosystem, yields theAREX-技能AREX-Skill库，其当前存储库快照包含从 1,000 个广泛使用的 ML 存储库中提取的 5,000 多种技能，并由超过 20 个区域和 178 个功能系列的路由器进行组织。每个存储库都被提炼成一个技能图，并且库级路由器将请求缩小到相关图。本文还研究了为评估而构建的论文衍生技能和任务导向技能。Library, whose current repository snapshot contains 5,000+ skills distilled from 1,000 widely used ML repositories and organized by a router over 20 areas and 178 capability families. Each repository is distilled into a skill graph, and the library-level router narrows a request to the relevant graphs. The paper also studies paper-derived and task-oriented skills constructed for the evaluations.

为了隔离蒸馏技能的影响，我们对使用和不使用它们的相同研究代理进行了比较To isolate the effect of distilled skills, we compare the same research agent with and without them onMLE 工作台MLE-bench (Chan et al., 2025), 纸凳PaperBench (Starace et al., 2025), 前沿CSFrontierCS (Mang et al., 2025), 和, and通行网PassNet (Liu et al., 2026)，保持 GPT-5.5 主干、研究工具和下游执行预算固定。技能构建在下游执行开始之前完成，因此技能是运行时唯一的变量。在这些匹配的设置下，配备技能的代理在 MLE-bench 上的得分高出 134.3%，在 PaperBench 上高出 34.4%，在 FrontierCS 上高出 9.2%，在 PassNet 上高出 14.0%。图, holding the GPT-5.5 backbone, research harness, and downstream execution budget fixed. Skill construction is completed before downstream execution begins, so skills are the only variable at run time. Under these matched settings, the skill-equipped agent scores 134.3% higher on MLE-bench, 34.4% higher on PaperBench, 9.2% higher on FrontierCS, and 14.0% higher on PassNet. Figure1(b) 总结了由此产生的堆栈和基准增益。(b) summarizes the resulting stack and benchmark gains.

2 自主研究的操作知识Operational Knowledge for Autonomous Research

我们首先形式化自主研究任务，然后隔离模型和工具的标准视图未指定的知识层。部分We first formalize an autonomous research task and then isolate the knowledge layer left unspecified by the standard view of a model and a harness. Section2.1定义任务和代理系统。部分defines the task and agentic system. Section2.2定义defines操作知识operational knowledge。部分. Section3实例化该层instantiates this layer with迪斯科DisCo.

2.1 初步Preliminary

和文物and the artifactsyy是轨迹留下的东西。自主研究机构的几乎所有进展都来自于加强这两个组成部分。随着每一代前沿技术的发展，骨干变得越来越强大，而线束工程也不断成熟are what the trajectory leaves behind. Nearly all progress on autonomous research agents has come from strengthening these two components. Backbones grow stronger with each frontier generation, while harness engineering continues to mature(Li et al., 2025a; Chen et al., 2026a; Jin et al., 2026)。然而，对于研究任务，两部分视图并未指定代理的特定领域操作知识。. For research tasks, however, the two-component view leaves the agent’s domain-specific operational knowledge unspecified.

2.2 定义操作知识Defining Operational Knowledge

要求在不熟悉的数据集上改进模型的代理必须决定哪种方法适合该问题，哪个包实现它，该包期望如何布置数据，哪些配置是合适的，以及哪些陷阱可能会使原本看似合理的运行无效。代理可以通过提出计划、运行计划、检查失败和修改来通过反复试验来推断这些选择。此类故障消耗的预算与用于评估的预算相同，并且配置错误的运行可能会花费很大一部分An agent asked to improve a model on an unfamiliar dataset must decide which method suits the problem, which package implements it, how that package expects the data to be laid out, which configurations are appropriate, and which pitfalls can invalidate an otherwise plausible run. The agent can infer these choices through trial and error by proposing a plan, running it, inspecting the failure, and revising. Such failures consume the same budget used for evaluation, and a misconfigured run may spend a large share ofℰ\mathcal{E}在产生有意义的测量之前。智能体在做出决策时需要的不是它最终能够达到的答案，而是一个已经可执行的答案。的任何一个组成部分before producing a meaningful measurement. What the agent needs at the moment of decision is not an answer it could eventually reach, but one that is already executable. Neither component of𝒜\mathcal{A}提供这些知识。骨干网的优先级广泛但固定，而线束控制程序但不提供领域内容。我们称缺失的为supplies this knowledge. The backbone’s prior is broad but fixed, while the harness controls procedure but does not supply domain content. We call what is missing操作知识operational knowledge，并将研究代理写为, and write a research agent as

𝒜res=(Mθ,H,𝒦),\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{res}}=(M_{\theta},H,\mathcal{K}), (4)

哪里where𝒦\mathcal{K}是作为显式操作上下文提供给代理的操作知识，因此等式： （is the operational knowledge made available to the agent as explicit operating context, so that Eq. (3) 变为) becomesat∼πθ​(a∣τ,ht,H,𝒦)a_{t}\sim\pi_{\theta}(a\mid\tau,h_{t},H,\mathcal{K}).

操作知识是将对某个领域的了解转化为能够在其中采取行动的能力。它将该领域的方法和工具与当前的问题结合起来，通过指定Operational knowledge is what turns knowing about a domain into being able to act in it. It binds the field’s methods and tools to the problem at hand by specifying什么what可以解决它,can solve it,当when每位候选人都提出申请，并且each candidate applies, and如何how应该使用它。it should be used.它有两个组成部分。第一个转弯It has two constituents. The first turns知识转化为能力knowledge into capability：方法、代码、模型和 API 被打包成代理可以实际调用的单元。第二个转弯: methods, code, models, and APIs are packaged into units the agent can actually invoke. The second turns能力纳入使用政策capability into usage policy：每个单元都有管理其使用的条件、原因和程序。这两个成分是互补的。没有策略的能力为代理提供了没有选择标准的工具。没有能力的策略在没有可执行接口的情况下提供建议。这种分离也区分了: every unit carries the conditions, reasons, and procedures that govern its use. The two constituents are complementary. Capability without policy gives the agent tools without selection criteria. Policy without capability gives it advice without an executable interface. This separation also distinguishes𝒦\mathcal{K}来自fromHH。线束专业化. The harness specializes如何how代理人探索，同时the agent explores, while𝒦\mathcal{K}专门specializes什么what代理人知道要考虑。the agent knows to consider.

声明性来源陈述有关方法、API 或设计选择的事实。一篇论文报道了一种技术可以提高准确性。存储库记录了 API 接受的内容。一篇博客文章解释了为什么这个技巧有效。所有这些都是有用的，但它们都没有直接指定针对给定问题的行动方案。声明性知识说明什么是有效的，而操作性知识将这些事实转化为任务级的行动。后者必定是从前者派生出来的。Declarative sources state facts about methods, APIs, or design choices. A paper reports that a technique improves accuracy. A repository documents what an API accepts. A blog post explains why a trick works. All of this is useful, but none of it directly specifies a course of action for a given problem. Declarative knowledge states what holds, while operational knowledge translates those facts into task-level actions. The latter must be derived from the former.

在当前实践中，这种推导是手动的。专家阅读包含声明性材料的论文、存储库和技术博客，将有用的部分包装到自定义工具和脚本中，并编写技能和使用说明，告诉代理何时以及如何调用它们。结果可能是真正的操作知识，但其成本与专家劳动力以及其编写的领域、堆栈和版本有关。与此同时，它所引用的声明性材料非常丰富并且不断更新。In current practice, this derivation is manual. An expert reads the papers, repositories, and technical blogs that contain the declarative material, wraps the useful parts into custom tools and scripts, and writes the skills and usage instructions that tell an agent when and how to invoke them. The result can be genuine operational knowledge, but its cost scales with expert labor and with the domain, stack, and release for which it was written. The declarative material it draws on, meanwhile, is abundant and continually updated.核心的方法论问题是从声明性来源自动、大规模地产生操作知识。The central methodological problem is to produce operational knowledge automatically and at scale from declarative sources.

3 迪斯科DisCo：生产和使用运营知识: Producing and Using Operational Knowledge

迪斯科DisCo将操作知识层实例化为技能，通过技能蒸馏构建它们，并在研究过程中将它们用作操作上下文。部分instantiates the operational-knowledge layer as skills, constructs them through skill distillation, and uses them as operating context during research. Section3.1定义技能和技能图。部分defines skills and skill graphs. Section3.2以任务无关和面向任务的形式描述蒸馏机制。部分describes the distillation mechanism in task-agnostic and task-oriented forms. Section3.3将生产和使用结合在一起brings production and use together in迪斯科DisCo.

框架的两部分（必须生成的层和必须使用的层）在单个代理中相遇。我们定义The two halves of the framework, a layer that must be produced and a layer that must be used, meet in a single agent. We define迪斯科DisCo作为一个研究代理，既创造技能又与它们一起研究，在相同的骨干和工具上以两种模式运行。在as a research agent that both creates skills and researches with them, operating in two modes over the same backbone and harness. In创造者模式creator mode, 迪斯科DisCo进行部分的蒸馏carries out the distillation of Section3.2。它范围、基础、构建和验证，然后存放接受的图表. It scopes, grounds, constructs, and verifies, then deposits the accepted graph𝒢\mathcal{G}在in theAREX-技能AREX-Skill图书馆（部分Library (Section4）。在). In研究员模式researcher mode, 迪斯科DisCo是方程的代理。 （is the agent of Eq. (4），解决任务), solving a taskτ\tau与with𝒦\mathcal{K}从那个图书馆取来的。该库连接了两种模式，创建者模式编写可接受的图表，研究人员模式检索它们。图drawn from that library. The library connects the two modes, with creator mode writing accepted graphs and researcher mode retrieving them. Figure2给出了一个紧凑的概述。gives a compact overview.

这些模式的成本故意不对称。创建者模式按每个来源支付一次，并根据随后使用结果的每项任务进行摊销。研究员模式只需为任务实际打开的内容付费。这种成本不对称使得该层在我们研究的设置中具有可扩展性。蒸馏在源生态系统允许的任何范围内离线运行，而代理解决The modes are deliberately asymmetric in cost. Creator mode is paid once per source and amortized over every task that later draws on the result. Researcher mode pays only for what a task actually opens. This cost asymmetry makes the layer scalable in the settings we study. Distillation runs offline at whatever breadth the source ecosystem allows, while the agent solvingτ\tau继承结果而不重新派生它。inherits the result without re-deriving it.

在研究人员模式下，剩下的问题是如何使用构建的图。Within researcher mode, the remaining question is how a constructed graph is consumed.迪斯科DisCo遵循渐进披露原则follows the progressive disclosure principle(Anthropic, 2025b)。代理不是阅读完整的图表，而是首先查看路由器或图表输入技能，该技能按范围和预期用途总结候选技能图表。然后，它选择一个切入点，并仅打开研究执行过程中所需的技能。每个生成的技能都以使用描述开始，帮助代理识别其相关性并将技能的程序、证据、检查和恢复操作加载到. Rather than reading the full graph, the agent first sees a router or graph entry skill that summarizes candidate skill graphs by scope and intended use. It then chooses an entry point and opens only the skills needed during research execution. Each generated skill begins with a use description that helps the agent recognize its relevance and load the skill’s procedures, evidence, checks, and recovery actions into𝒦\mathcal{K}.

中的链接The links in𝒢\mathcal{G}将相同的选择过程扩展到第一项技能之外。例如，入门技能可以路由到组件技能以进行设置、评估、诊断或修复。这些链接使路由、依赖关系和组合关系对代理可见。在研究任务期间，代理可以在需要时从开放技能移动到引用技能，而无需阅读图表的不相关部分。通过这种方式，技能图提供了选择性的操作环境，同时线束继续控制规划、动作选择、工具使用和观察。extend the same selection process beyond the first skill. For instance, an entry skill can route to component skills for setup, evaluation, diagnosis, or repair. These links make routing, dependency, and composition relations visible to the agent. During a research task, the agent can move from an opened skill to a referenced skill when needed without reading unrelated parts of the graph. In this way, skill graphs provide selective operating context while the harness continues to control planning, action selection, tool use, and observation.

该界面添加了操作上下文而不是新的控制循环。技能图并不是运行代理的新方式，它将缺失的知识层与线束设计分开。相同的精炼技能可以服务于任何公开代理可读技能的兼容工具，而每个工具都保留自己的规划策略、工具接口和执行循环。The interface adds operating context rather than a new control loop. A skill graph is not a new way of running an agent, which keeps the missing knowledge layer separate from harness design. The same distilled skills can serve any compatible harness that exposes agent-readable skills, while each harness retains its own planning policy, tool interface, and execution loop.

4.1 存储库集合Repository Collection

范围。Scope.

我们根据开源可见性和实际使用情况选择 1,000 个 ML 存储库，其中 GitHub 星标属于精选信号。该集合涵盖模型实施、培训和部署系统、数据和评估工具以及科学软件。它是常用机器学习软件的精选快照，而不是生态系统的详尽分区。We select 1,000 ML repositories based on open-source visibility and practical use, with GitHub stars among the curation signals. The collection spans model implementations, training and deployment systems, data and evaluation tools, and scientific software. It is a curated snapshot of commonly used ML software rather than an exhaustive partition of the ecosystem.

技能图构建。Skill Graph construction.

对于每个存储库，For each repository,迪斯科DisCo使用与任务无关的过程构建经过验证的技能图constructs a verified skill graph using the task-agnostic procedure inSection 3.2。施工使用 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6-sol. Construction uses GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6-sol with高xhigh推理工作，每个存储库平均分配约 40 美元。证据边界包括存储库源、文档、示例、测试、脚本和配置。该图将支持的工作流程分解为数据准备、训练、推理、评估、服务、故障排除或维护的技能。参考和脚本保留执行这些工作流程所需的详细信息。reasoning effort, at an average allocation of about $40 per repository. The evidence boundary includes repository source, documentation, examples, tests, scripts, and configuration. The graph decomposes supported workflows into skills for data preparation, training, inference, evaluation, serving, troubleshooting, or maintenance. References and scripts retain the details needed to execute these workflows.

在纳入之前，Before inclusion,迪斯科DisCo使用断言支持的案例和安全存储库本机示例、测试、CLI 检查、微型夹具检查或烟雾脚本（如果可用）检查每个图表的内容和可用性。归因于图表的故障会触发本地修复并重新运行相关检查。附录checks each graph’s content and usability using assertion-backed cases and safe repository-native examples, tests, CLI checks, tiny-fixture checks, or smoke scripts when available. A failure attributed to the graph triggers local repair and reruns of the relevant checks. AppendixA.1给出了构建和验证细节。gives the construction and verification details.

覆盖范围。Coverage.

存储库快照包含 1,000 个存储库图表中的 5,353 项技能，分为 20 个领域和 178 个功能系列。它记录了 2,209 个存储库到区域到家庭路径的精确分配，其中 700 个存储库出现在多个家庭中。附录The repository snapshot contains 5,353 skills across 1,000 repository graphs, organized into 20 areas and 178 capability families. It records 2,209 exact assignments of repositories to area-to-family paths, with 700 repositories appearing in more than one family. AppendixB列出路由覆盖范围。纸质图表和任务导向图表不包括在这些计数中。lists the routed coverage. Paper-derived and task-oriented graphs are not included in these counts.

4.2 分类和路由Taxonomy and Routing

分类学构建。Taxonomy construction.

存储库分类在最终分配之前已确定。我们冻结每个来源的简短存储库摘要，并从这些描述中归纳出区域和族的两级树。星级、URL 和预先存在的类别字段从模型输入中排除。 LLM 辅助的流程提出了一个完整的树，在 100 个稳定批次的 10 个存储库上对其进行评估，并使用单独的定位器和法官调用，并使用法官审查以及确定性拟合和家庭负载统计数据对其进行修改。临时放置仅用于诊断。最终路线在分类确定后分配。附录The repository taxonomy is fixed before final assignment. We freeze a short repository summary for each source and induce a two-level tree of areas and families from these descriptions. Stars, URLs, and pre-existing category fields are excluded from the model input. The LLM-assisted pipeline proposes a complete tree, evaluates it on 100 stable batches of 10 repositories with separate locator and judge calls, and revises it using judge reviews together with deterministic fit and family-load statistics. Provisional placements are used only for diagnosis. Final routes are assigned after the taxonomy is fixed. AppendixA.1给出了实施细节。gives the implementation details.

存储库分配。Repository assignment.

分类法确定后，每个经过验证的图表都会根据精确的区域到家庭路径进行分类。原始存储库作为主要证据源，而生成的图表用于导航。每项任务都需要理由、存储证据和信心。仅关键字、仅依赖项、可选集成和仅示例匹配将被拒绝。一个存储库可以接收多个分配，并且当不支持确切的族时，图保持未分类。After the taxonomy is fixed, each verified graph is classified against exact area-to-family paths. The original repository serves as the primary evidence source, while the generated graph is used for navigation. Each assignment requires a rationale, repository evidence, and confidence. Keyword-only, dependency-only, optional-integration, and example-only matches are rejected. A repository may receive multiple assignments, and a graph remains unclassified when no exact family is supported.

路由器的产生和使用。Router generation and use.

接受的作业从存储库和作业索引编译到路由器中，用于生成区域和家庭页面。在研究过程中，模型从路由器描述开始，遵循相关的区域到家庭路径，打开选定的存储库图，并仅加载当前步骤所需的技能、参考或脚本。当它们提供不同的功能时，它可以打开多个图表，但当没有一个家庭非常适合时，它不会强制选择一条路线。这实现了渐进式披露Accepted assignments are compiled into a router from repository and assignment indexes, which are used to generate the area and family pages. During research, the model starts with the router description, follows the relevant area-to-family path, opens the selected repository graph, and loads only the skills, references, or scripts needed for the current step. It can open several graphs when they provide distinct capabilities, but does not force a route when no family is a close fit. This implements progressive disclosure(Anthropic, 2025b)，因此只有选定的分支进入操作上下文, so only the selected branch enters the operating context𝒦\mathcal{K}.

4.3 论文衍生和任务导向的技能Paper-Derived and Task-Oriented Skills

纸衍生的技能。Paper-derived skills.

论文提供了第二个与任务无关的源锚点。Papers provide a second task-agnostic source anchor.迪斯科DisCo将每篇论文分解为模块级技能，涵盖方法组件、数据或评估程序以及实施工作流程。每个模块都被单独检查，然后进行有界恢复实验，排除原始实现存储库。decomposes each paper into module-level skills covering method components, data or evaluation procedures, and implementation workflows. Each module is checked in isolation, followed by a bounded recovery experiment that excludes the original implementation repository.

对于当前的研究，我们将此工作流程应用于为 20 个 PaperBench 目标选择的先前论文。这从 153 篇源论文中产生了 636 项论文衍生技能。相关工作上下文决定了每个目标可以使用哪些源论文技能，而目标论文及其发布的工件被排除在技能源之外。由此产生的技能在目标之外仍然可以重复使用。附录For the current study, we apply this workflow to prior papers selected for the 20 PaperBench targets. This produces 636 paper-derived skills from 153 source papers. Related-work context determines which source-paper skills are available to each target, while the target paper and its released artifacts are excluded as skill sources. The resulting skills remain reusable beyond the target. AppendixA.2.2给出了构建协议，以及部分gives the construction protocol, and Section5.3评估生成的池。如果验证预算允许，相同的工作流程可以扩展到其他论文。evaluates the resulting pools. The same workflow can be extended to additional papers as verification budget permits.

以任务为导向的技能。Task-oriented skills.

我们还为基准构建技能，其操作知识由任务界面和反馈信号定义。 MLE-bench 为 75 个竞赛中的每一个竞赛使用一个描述性图表，这些图表是通过任务分解、源发现和有界诊断试验构建的，排除了特定于竞赛的内容。 FrontierCS 使用一个在 188 个代理跟踪任务之间共享的面向恢复的图。 PassNet 使用一个基准级图来进行 FX 图检查、模式匹配、语义保留重写、Triton 实施和性能诊断。附录We also construct skills for benchmarks whose operational knowledge is defined by a task interface and feedback signal. MLE-bench uses one descriptive graph for each of 75 competitions, built through task decomposition, source discovery, and bounded diagnostic trials, with competition-specific content excluded. FrontierCS uses one recovery-oriented graph shared across its 188 Agent Track tasks. PassNet uses one benchmark-level graph for FX-graph inspection, pattern matching, semantics-preserving rewrites, Triton implementation, and performance diagnosis. AppendixA.2.1、附录, AppendixA.2.3、和附录, and AppendixA.2.4描述这些结构。部分describe these constructions. Sections5.2, 5.4, 和, and5.5评价他们。evaluate them.

5 实验Experiments

我们评估We evaluate迪斯科DisCo通过为 PaperBench 构建基于纸张的技能池以及为 MLE-bench、FrontierCS 和 PassNet 构建面向任务的技能图，超越公共存储库快照。在每个设置中，beyond the public repository snapshot by constructing paper-derived skill pools for PaperBench and task-oriented skill graphs for MLE-bench, FrontierCS, and PassNet. In each setting,迪斯科DisCo在任务的来源限制、评估协议和验证条件下构建技能，然后我们衡量由此产生的操作环境是否改善了固定的研究代理。constructs skills under the task’s source constraints, evaluation protocol, and verification conditions, and we measure whether the resulting operating context improves a fixed research agent.

5.1 设置Setup

提炼出来的技能充当操作环境，而不是新的控制循环，因此它们可以附加到固定的研究工具上。我们使用法典Distilled skills act as operating context rather than as a new control loop, so they can be attached to a fixed research harness. We use Codex(OpenAI, 2025)作为安全带并保留as the harness and keep theGPT-5.5骨干与backbone with高xhigh推理工作在不同条件下都是固定的。唯一受控的因素是代理是否配备reasoning effort fixed across conditions. The only controlled factor is whether the agent is equipped with迪斯科DisCo- 精炼技能（-distilled skills (有技能with skills）或不（) or not (没有技能without skills).

MLE 工作台。MLE-bench.

在 MLE 工作台上On MLE-bench(Chan et al., 2025)，我们评估, we evaluate the满full套房suite of75所有三个难度级别（低、中、高）的比赛。我们按难度划分报告 MLE-bench 的标题任意奖牌得分。最终分级使用基准的保留分级机。对于每项任务，我们在尝试之前都会构建一个专用的操作知识技能图，提炼通过网络搜索收集的知识源，同时排除原始竞赛网页和竞赛特定内容。技能构建和基准执行使用单独的每任务预算。在有技能和无技能条件下进行比较competitions across all three difficulty tiers (Low, Medium, High). We report MLE-bench’s headline Any-Medal score by difficulty split. Final grading uses the benchmark’s held-out grader. For each task, we construct a dedicated operational-knowledge skill graph before attempting it, distilling knowledge sources collected through web search while excluding the original competition webpage and competition-specific content. Skill construction and benchmark execution use separate per-task budgets. The with- and without-skills conditions are compared under a匹配的运行预算matched running budget，而一次性构建预算是单独的，并且在任一运行时条件下都不计算在内。完整的程序在附录中描述, while the one-time construction budget is separate and is not counted in either run-time condition. The full procedure is described in AppendixA.2.1.

纸凳。PaperBench.

纸凳上On PaperBench(Starace et al., 2025)，我们运行完整的任务集, we run the full task set of20论文，由基准测试的官方复制评分器进行评估。对于每篇论文，在尝试复制之前，我们选择目标论文的相关工作部分中引用的相关作品，并从这些论文及其相应的存储库中提取技能，同时排除目标论文本身以及任何随附的已发布代码或工件。与 MLE-bench 一样，技能构建和基准测试执行使用单独的每个任务预算。在有技能和无技能条件下进行比较papers, evaluated with the benchmark’s official replication grader. For each paper, before attempting the reproduction, we select relevant works cited in the target paper’s related-work section and distill skills from these papers and their corresponding repositories, while excluding the target paper itself and any accompanying released code or artifacts. As in MLE-bench, skill construction and benchmark execution use separate per-task budgets. The with- and without-skills conditions are compared under a匹配的运行预算matched running budget，而一次性构建预算是单独的，并且在任一运行时条件下都不计算在内。完整的程序在附录中描述, while the one-time construction budget is separate and is not counted in either run-time condition. The full procedure is described in AppendixA.2.2.

前沿CS。FrontierCS.

前沿CSFrontierCS(Mang et al., 2025)包括开放式计算机科学问题，即使最优值未知，其解决方案的质量也是可以客观测量的。我们评估所有comprises open-ended computer-science problems whose solution quality is objectively measurable even when the optimum is unknown. We evaluate all188代理通过 Harbor 跟踪任务Agent Track tasks through Harbor(Harbor Framework Team, 2026)。每个任务运行都有 5 小时的预算，代理容器仅限于 2 个 CPU 和 4 GiB RAM。代理检查问题，实现 C++ 求解器，并可以通过迭代提交来改进它。保留的任务分数是任何中间提交的最佳分数。每个任务的测试用例继承该任务自己的判断限制，整个套件的范围从 0.25 到 100 s，从 128 MiB 到 2 GiB。按照排行榜惯例，我们报告平均得分以及步骤、工具调用和令牌中每个任务的平均使用情况。对于此基准测试，我们构建了一个跨所有任务共享的单一技能图。构建和细化在评估之前完成，之后所有配备技能的运行的图表都被冻结。附录中提供了更多详细信息. Each task run has a 5-hour budget, and the agent container is limited to 2 CPUs and 4 GiB of RAM. The agent inspects the problem, implements a C++ solver, and may improve it through iterative submissions. The retained task score is the best score from any intermediate submission. The test cases for each task inherit that task’s own judge limits, which range from 0.25 to 100 s and from 128 MiB to 2 GiB across the suite. Following the leaderboard convention, we report average score together with mean per-task usage in steps, tool calls, and tokens. For this benchmark, we construct a single skill graph shared across all tasks. Construction and refinement are completed before evaluation, after which the graph is frozen for all skill-equipped runs. Further details are provided in AppendixA.2.3.

通网．PassNet.

通行网PassNet(Liu et al., 2026)目标是图形编译器传递生成，其中每个任务都需要构造一个模式匹配器和重写器，以保留语义，同时提高执行性能。我们按照基准惯例报告了四个补充指标。 AS 分数是主要基准分数。对于每个样本，PassNet 计算 ES(targets graph-compiler pass generation, where each task requires constructing a pattern matcher and rewriter that preserve semantics while improving execution performance. We report four complementary metrics following the benchmark convention. AS Score is the primary benchmark score. For each sample, PassNet computes ES(tt）作为超过公差水平的修正子图加速的几何平均值) as the geometric mean of rectified subgraph speedups over tolerance levelst∈[−10,4]t\in[-10,4]，然后使用官方加权几何平均协议聚合这些每个样本的分数，然后再对样本进行平均。修正后的加速比为不正确或不匹配的传递分配 0.1 的下限值。其他三个指标是在容差下计算的, then aggregates these per-sample scores using the official weighted geometric-mean protocol before averaging across samples. The rectified speedup assigns a floor value of 0.1 to incorrect or unmatched passes. The other three metrics are computed at tolerancet=−5t=-5。 G 均值加速是数值正确的子图上端到端加速的几何平均值。正确性是其输出在指定容差下与急切模式参考相匹配的子图的分数。 Fast_1 是至少与急切执行一样快的正确子图的份额。所有评估均在 NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB 上进行。完整的程序在附录中描述. G-Mean Speedup is the geometric mean of end-to-end speedups over numerically correct subgraphs. Correctness is the fraction of subgraphs whose outputs match the eager-mode reference at the specified tolerance. Fast_1 is the share of correct subgraphs that are at least as fast as eager execution. All evaluations are conducted on NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB. The full procedure is described in AppendixA.2.4.

5.2 主要结果：MLE 基准（完整）Main Results: MLE-bench (Full)

Table 1Codex 将具有或不具有精炼技能的 Codex 与公共 MLE 基准排行榜上的强大代理进行了比较。所有报告的结果均使用完整的 75 项任务套件。compares Codex with and without distilled skills against strong agents from the public MLE-bench leaderboard. All reported results use the full 75-task suite.

技能改进了 MLE 平台上的 Codex。Skills improve Codex on MLE-bench.

增加技能后，在不改变特工骨干的情况下，Any-Medal 的总体得分从 31.11% 提高到 72.89%，提高了 41.78 个百分点，相对提高了 134.3%。所有难度级别的收益都是一致的：低难度为 43.94 点，中难度为 37.72 点，高难度为 48.89 点。相对收益在高任务上尤其明显，分数从 13.33% 上升至 62.22%，相当于提高了 366.8%，即无技能分数的 4.67 倍。在相同的代理和任务预算下，这一结果支持了我们的中心假设，即提炼的操作知识可以提高机器学习研究性能。Adding skills raises the overall Any-Medal score from 31.11% to 72.89%, a gain of 41.78 percentage points and a 134.3% relative improvement, without changing the agent backbone. The gains are consistent across all difficulty tiers: 43.94 points on Low, 37.72 points on Medium, and 48.89 points on High. The relative gain is particularly pronounced on High tasks, where the score rises from 13.33% to 62.22%, corresponding to a 366.8% improvement, or 4.67 times the no-skill score. Under the same agent and task budget, this result supports our central hypothesis that distilled operational knowledge can improve ML research performance.

增益不需要新的线束。The gain does not require a new harness.

法典的技能也超过了最强的公共基线Codex with skills also surpasses the strongest public baseline inTable 1，将总体得分从 64.44% 提高到 72.89%（+8.45 分）。每个难度级别相对于最佳公开分数的相应增益为“低”6.06 分、“中”5.26 分、“高”15.55 分。此比较使用带有附加精炼技能的普通 Codex，没有自定义执行工具、专门的代理编排策略或修改的控制循环。该比较隔离了固定法典框架下外部化操作知识的贡献。, improving the overall score from 64.44% to 72.89% (+8.45 points). The corresponding gains over the best public score in each difficulty tier are 6.06 points on Low, 5.26 points on Medium, and 15.55 points on High. This comparison uses vanilla Codex with added distilled skills, without a custom execution harness, specialized agent orchestration strategy, or modified control loop. The comparison isolates the contribution of externalized operational knowledge under the fixed Codex harness.

优势随着任务难度的增加而增加。The advantage grows with task difficulty.

最大的收益出现在高难度任务上，无论是针对没有技能的 Codex（+48.89 分）还是针对最强的公共基线（+15.55 分）。较困难的任务通常会让代理接触更大的库、实现和优化选择空间，从而使无指导的试错成本更高。观察到的趋势与指导代理搜索适用工具、经过验证的工作流程和明确检查的技能是一致的。代理可以更早地进入解决方案空间的高效区域，并将其迭代重点放在直接影响目标指标的实现和优化选择上，而不是花费预算探索不合适的代码路径。这种在困难任务上的强劲趋势表明，随着机器学习问题变得更加复杂，精炼技能的价值可能会增加。The largest gains appear on High-difficulty tasks, both against Codex without skills (+48.89 points) and against the strongest public baseline (+15.55 points). Harder tasks typically expose the agent to a larger space of libraries, implementations, and optimization choices, making unguided trial and error more costly. The observed trend is consistent with skills guiding the agent’s search toward applicable tools, validated workflows, and explicit checks. Instead of spending its budget exploring unsuitable code paths, the agent can enter a productive region of the solution space earlier and focus its iterations on implementation and optimization choices that directly affect the target metric. This stronger trend on difficult tasks suggests that the value of distilled skills may increase as ML problems become more complex.

On what-will-my-model-forget, it rises from 9.35 to 30.45, a 3.3×\times增加。相比之下，无技能基线已经中等到高的任务，例如 all-in-one (52.93) 和 bam (56.65)，绝对收益较小（分别为 +1.77 和 +2.18）。此模式与 FrontierCS 恢复分析相匹配，当无指导的尝试在实现细节、环境设置或特定于方法的组件上停滞时，技能最有帮助。increase. In contrast, tasks where the no-skill baseline is already moderate to high, such as all-in-one (52.93) and bam (56.65), see smaller absolute gains (+1.77 and +2.18, respectively). This pattern matches the FrontierCS recovery analysis, where skills help most when unguided attempts stall on implementation details, environment setup, or method-specific components.

少数任务会在技能下回归。A small number of tasks regress under skills.

有两项任务在使用技能时得分低于没有技能时的得分：样本特定掩模（57.11Two tasks score lower with skills than without: sample-specific-masks (57.11→\to 52.04, −-5.07）和切入主题（32.315.07) and stay-on-topic (32.31→\to 27.79, −-4.52）。两者的无技能得分均高于 20 项任务的平均值 (29.45)，表明可能存在检索精度失败的情况。检索到的技能内容有时可能会分散基本代理自行发现的任务特定策略的注意力。这与技能检索中适度的精确回忆权衡是一致的。对于那些复制依赖于狭窄的、特殊的实现选择而没有被构建的技能图很好地覆盖的论文，遵循检索到的技能可能会让智能体远离它在没有帮助的情况下会收敛的方法。当检索到的技能不匹配时，更好的路由或明确回退到无指导的推理可能会减少这种失败模式。4.52). Both have no-skill scores above the 20-task average (29.45), suggesting a possible retrieval-precision failure. Retrieved skill content may occasionally distract from a task-specific strategy that the base agent would otherwise discover on its own. This is consistent with a modest precision-recall trade-off in skill retrieval. For papers whose replication depends on a narrow, idiosyncratic implementation choice not well covered by the constructed skill graph, following the retrieved skill may pull the agent away from an approach it would have converged on unaided. Better routing or an explicit fallback to unguided reasoning when retrieved skills are a poor match may reduce this failure mode.

技能可提高 FrontierCS 分数。Skills improve FrontierCS scores.

The aggregate positive change is 3.91×\times总体负面变化的幅度。所有 188 个任务的配对引导程序产生的 95% 置信区间为the magnitude of the aggregate negative change. 技能恢复低分问题。Skills recover lower-scoring problems.

按无技能分数分层，最大的提升出现在 50 分以下的 47 项任务上，其平均值从 19.43 上升到 45.99 (+26.56)，其中 30 项改进的任务跨越了 50 分阈值。更广泛地说，技能条件使分数分布向上移动，增加达到中等、高和接近完成分数的任务数量。这些结果表明，当无指导的探索未能找到可行的方案或实施时，操作指导尤其有价值。Stratifying by the no-skill score, the largest lift occurs on the 47 tasks below 50, whose mean rises from 19.43 to 45.99 (+26.56), with 30 improved tasks crossing the 50-point threshold. More broadly, the skills condition shifts the score distribution upward, increasing the number of tasks that reach moderate, high, and near-complete scores. These results suggest that operating guidance is particularly valuable when unguided exploration fails to find a workable formulation or implementation.

技能可以提高性能，而不仅仅是原始资源扩展。Skills improve performance beyond raw resource scaling.

5.5 主要结果：PassNetMain Results: PassNet

PassNet 在图形编译器通道生成上评估代理，其中解决方案必须构建一个模式匹配器和重写器，以保留图形语义，同时提高执行性能。我们保持 Codex 工具和 GPT-5.5 主干固定，仅在代理是否收到PassNet evaluates agents on graph-compiler pass generation, where a solution must construct a pattern matcher and rewriter that preserve graph semantics while improving execution performance. We keep the Codex harness and GPT-5.5 backbone fixed and vary only whether the agent receives the迪斯科DisCo- 提炼了 PassNet 技能，使我们能够隔离操作上下文的影响。结果见表-distilled PassNet skill, allowing us to isolate the effect of the operating context. 精炼技能改进了 PassNet 上的 Codex。Distilled skills improve Codex on PassNet.

The geometric-mean speedup also increases from 1.5891 to 1.6688. This improvement is consistent with skills guiding the agent toward more reliable, semantically valid, and higher-scoring passes.

6 相关工作Related Work

6.1 自主机器学习研究Autonomous ML Research

最近的工作研究了机器学习研究生命周期的自主系统Recent work studies autonomous systems for the ML research lifecycle(Dong et al., 2026)。自主发现系统将构思、实施、实验和写入端到端管道相结合. Autonomous-discovery systems chain ideation, implementation, experimentation, and writing into end-to-end pipelines(Lu et al., 2024; Yamada et al., 2025; Schmidgall et al., 2025; Tang et al., 2025; Karpathy, 2026)。互补链研究. A complementary strand studies research构思ideation处于孤立状态。大规模人体研究比较了法学硕士和专家的研究想法in isolation. Large-scale human studies compare LLM-generated and expert research ideas(Si et al., 2025)，而迭代代理则根据科学文献生成和完善想法, while iterative agents generate and refine ideas over the scientific literature(Baek et al., 2025)。第二组工作直接针对机器学习工程和数据科学。代理通过提议-运行-评估循环来解决此类任务. A second cluster of work targets ML engineering and data science directly. Agents solve such tasks through propose–run–evaluate loops(Jiang et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2025)，基于案例的先前解决方案的重用, case-based reuse of prior solutions(Guo et al., 2024)、多智能体竞争管道, multi-agent competition pipelines(Li et al., 2024)，层次任务图, hierarchical task graphs(Hong et al., 2025)，对候选管道进行树搜索, tree search over candidate pipelines(Chi et al., 2024)，以及对执行反馈的强化学习, and reinforcement learning over execution feedback(Liu et al., 2025)。他们的进展通过衡量端到端机器学习实验、工程、研究和论文复制的基准来跟踪. Their progress is tracked by benchmarks that measure end-to-end ML experimentation, engineering, research, and paper reproduction(Huang et al., 2024; Chan et al., 2025; Starace et al., 2025; Wijk et al., 2025)以及自动化纸张到代码复制的相关工作, alongside a related line of work on automated paper-to-code reproduction(Zhou et al., 2025; Seo et al., 2026; Li et al., 2025b)。最近的分析还指出，一旦离开单一范围明确的存储库，代理就会变得多么脆弱. Recent analyses also note how brittle agents become once they leave a single well-scoped repository(Chen et al., 2026b).

这些系统很大程度上孤立地处理每项任务。代理从每个任务的底层工件中重新学习每个库、配置和启动过程，因此这项工作不会在任务之间分摊。我们的工作是对代理设计进步的补充。我们没有引入新的控制循环，而是提取了兼容代理可以使用的可重用操作知识层，并使用这些基准来衡量其对代理性能的影响。我们的验证进一步利用对抗性多智能体审查，其动机是对多智能体系统中的协调和验证失败进行分析These systems treat each task largely in isolation. An agent relearns each library, configuration, and launch procedure from the underlying artifacts on every task, so this effort is not amortized across tasks. Our work is complementary to advances in agent design. Rather than introducing a new control loop, we distill a reusable operational-knowledge layer that compatible agents can consume, and we use these benchmarks to measure its effect on agent performance. Our verification further draws on adversarial multi-agent review, motivated by analyses of coordination and verification failures in multi-agent systems(Cemri et al., 2026).

6.2 代理技巧Agent Skills

代理技能通过可重用的程序知识扩展语言模型代理，而无需修改模型参数。根据代理技能规范，技能是一种可检查的工件，以Agent skills extend language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge without modifying model parameters. Under the Agent Skills specification, a skill is an inspectable artifact centered on a技能.mdSKILL.md描述激活条件、过程和工具使用策略的文件，可选地附有通过渐进式披露加载的脚本和参考file that describes activation conditions, procedures, and tool-use strategies, optionally accompanied by scripts and references loaded through progressive disclosure(Anthropic, 2025b)。与潜在策略或情景记忆不同，此类技能是可移植且可明确修改的工件。然而，对现有的大规模分析. Unlike latent policies or episodic memories, such skills are portable and explicitly modifiable artifacts. However, large-scale analysis of existing技能.mdSKILL.md文件揭示了创作不一致的情况，凸显了大规模创建高质量技能的难度files reveals authoring inconsistencies, highlighting the difficulty of creating high-quality skills at scale(Hong et al., 2026).

先前的工作已经探索从代理经验中自动获取可重用的知识。 Voyager 学习并组合跨环境的可执行技能Prior work has explored automatically acquiring reusable knowledge from agent experience. Voyager learns and composes executable skills across environments(Wang et al., 2024)、代理工作流内存从过去的轨迹中提取可重用的例程, Agent Workflow Memory extracts reusable routines from past trajectories(Wang et al., 2025)，ExpeL 从任务经验中提取自然语言见解, and ExpeL distills natural-language insights from task experiences(Zhao et al., 2024)。然而，这些方法主要从交互跟踪中导出自由格式的代码、工作流程或见解，使得技能质量难以验证，故障难以归因。相比之下，我们蒸馏. However, these methods mainly derive free-form code, workflows, or insights from interaction traces, making skill quality difficult to verify and failures difficult to attribute. In contrast, we distill版本特定的操作知识version-specific operational knowledge从静态 ML 工件（例如论文和存储库）到from static ML artifacts, such as papers and repositories, into有来源且经过验证provenance-grounded and verified具有明确验证记录的代理技能。Agent Skills with explicit validation records.

7 结论Conclusion

在本文中，我们将操作知识作为 ML 研究代理的缺失层进行研究。In this paper, we study operational knowledge as a missing layer for ML research agents.迪斯科DisCo通过将源知识提炼成可重用的操作知识技能图来填充这一层，这些操作知识技能图可以作为操作上下文加载，同时保持模型主干和研究工具不变。缩放fills this layer by distilling source knowledge into reusable operational-knowledge skill graphs that can be loaded as operating context while leaving the model backbone and research harness unchanged. Scaling迪斯科DisCo产生yields theAREX-技能AREX-Skill库，其存储库快照包含从 1,000 个广泛使用的 ML 存储库中提取的 5,000 多种技能。我们还为这项工作中评估的研究环境构建了源自论文和任务导向的技能。Library, whose repository snapshot contains 5,000+ skills distilled from 1,000 widely used ML repositories. We also construct paper-derived and task-oriented skills for the research settings evaluated in this work.

在固定的 GPT-5.5 Codex 设置和匹配的下游预算下，配备技能的代理在 MLE-bench 上的得分高出 134.3%，在 PaperBench 上高出 34.4%，在 FrontierCS 上高出 9.2%，在 PassNet 上高出 14.0%。这些结果支持了一个中心论点，即自主研究代理可以通过增加操作知识来改进，而不是仅仅依赖于更强大的控制循环。线束专门研究智能体的研究方式，而精炼技能则专门研究研究开始时需要考虑的内容。Under a fixed GPT-5.5 Codex setup and matched downstream budgets, the skill-equipped agent scores 134.3% higher on MLE-bench, 34.4% higher on PaperBench, 9.2% higher on FrontierCS, and 14.0% higher on PassNet. These results support the central claim that autonomous research agents can improve by adding operational knowledge rather than relying only on stronger control loops. Harnesses specialize how an agent researches, while distilled skills specialize what it knows to consider when research begins.

附录AAppendix A迪斯科DisCo实施Implementations

本附录描述了三个实例This appendix describes three instantiations of迪斯科DisCo在本作品中使用。公共存储库集合将版本化的软件源提取为可重用的与任务无关的图表。 PaperBench 实现将先前的论文提炼为源锚定模块技能，并为每次复制组装一个目标条件池。相反，MLE-bench、FrontierCS 和 PassNet 将面向任务的构建锚定在竞争或基准界面上。所有实施均遵循以下四个阶段used in this work. The public repository collection distills versioned software sources into reusable task-agnostic graphs. The PaperBench implementation distills prior papers into source-anchored module skills and assembles a target-conditioned pool for each reproduction. MLE-bench, FrontierCS, and PassNet instead anchor task-oriented construction on a competition or benchmark interface. All implementations follow the four stages inSection 3.2，但在源选择、图形粒度和验证信号方面有所不同。, but differ in source selection, graph granularity, and verification signal.

A.1 与任务无关的 ML 存储库技能构建Task-Agnostic ML Repository Skill Construction

对于与任务无关的存储库集合，For the task-agnostic repository collection,迪斯科DisCo运行蒸馏程序runs the distillation procedure inSection 3.2针对每个选定的 ML 存储库执行一次，遵循存储的存储库到技能程序，该程序指定如何针对此类源执行四个阶段。构建单元是一个版本化上游存储库的独立操作知识技能图。存储库图生产使用 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6-solonce for each selected ML repository, following a stored repo-to-skill procedure that specifies how the four stages are carried out for this type of source. The construction unit is a self-contained operational-knowledge skill graph for one versioned upstream repository. Repository graph production uses GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6-sol with高xhigh每个存储库的推理工作量和平均建设拨款约为 40 美元。锚reasoning effort and an average construction allocation of about $40 per repository. The anchorzz是存储库快照及其可检查的证据，包括元数据、源根、文档、示例、测试、配置文件和存储库拥有的脚本。的能力is the repository snapshot together with its inspectable evidence, including metadata, source roots, documentation, examples, tests, configuration files, and repo-owned scripts. The capabilities in𝒬\mathcal{Q}是包级 ML 研究工作所需的内容，例如选择接口、调整代码、检查输出以及从特定于包的故障中恢复。验证结合了可用性案例、安全本机检查和静态检查，并且图表围绕存储库级输入技能以及需要时的重点组件技能进行组织。are those needed for package-level ML research work, such as choosing interfaces, adapting code, checking outputs, and recovering from package-specific failures. Verification combines usability cases, safe native checks, and static checks, and the graph is organized around a repository-level entry skill with focused component skills when needed.

范围界定和基础确定了存储库证据边界。Scoping and grounding fix the repository evidence boundary.

迪斯科DisCo在安装或执行包代码之前首先分析存储库。此过程在源根、文档、示例、测试、脚本、配置文件和现有存储库本地技能（如果存在）上构建包含/排除证据图。它还记录用于本机测试或示例候选以及源脚本处理的仅构​​造映射。生成的文件、构建输出、供应商依赖项、本地环境、缓存、大型工件和不相关的开发内部构件都被排除在外，除非请求的存储库工作流程需要它们。此边界使生成的技能图与公共的、可重用的包行为相关联，而不是与任意的签出状态相关联。first analyzes the repository before installing or executing package code. This pass builds an include/exclude evidence map over source roots, documentation, examples, tests, scripts, configuration files, and existing repo-local skills when present. It also records construction-only maps for native test or example candidates and source-script handling. Generated files, build outputs, vendored dependencies, local environments, caches, large artifacts, and unrelated development internals are excluded unless they are needed for the requested repository workflow. This boundary keeps the resulting skill graph tied to public, reusable package behavior rather than arbitrary checkout state.

范围确定后，After the scope is fixed,迪斯科DisCo准备一个私有的Python检查环境。安装计划仅限于选定的证据和用户要求，当较小的依赖项集就足够时，避免了广泛的额外内容。实时检查检查导入名称、包版本、公共签名、CLI 入口点、可选后端和小型运行时行为。文档和测试建立工作流意图，而源代码和实时检查在 API 和运行时声明进入技能图之前确认它们。本地路径和特定于机器的设置仍然是私有的构建证据。prepares a private Python inspection environment. The install plan is limited to the selected evidence and user requirements, avoiding broad extras when a smaller dependency set is sufficient. Live inspection checks import names, package versions, public signatures, CLI entry points, optional backends, and small runtime behaviors. Documentation and tests establish workflow intent, while source code and live inspection confirm API and runtime claims before they enter the skill graph. Local paths and machine-specific setup remain private construction evidence.

构建编写一个独立的存储库图。Construction writes a self-contained repository graph.

生成的图表从存储库级别的输入技能开始。该入口技能保持类似路由器的状态。它说明了何时应用包，提供最少的设置或导入检查，并将代理路由到不同工作流程的组件技能，例如数据准备、培训、评估、服务、故障排除或存储库维护（如果有证据支持）。每个组件技能都涵盖有限的工作流程，并链接到附近的参考或脚本，以获取 API 详细信息、命令构造、数据格式、验证检查和恢复过程。分割是由未来可能的代理任务决定的，而不是仅由源目录名称决定。The generated graph starts with a repository-level entry skill. This entry skill is kept router-like. It states when the package applies, provides minimal setup or import checks, and routes the agent to component skills for distinct workflows such as data preparation, training, evaluation, serving, troubleshooting, or repository maintenance when supported by the evidence. Each component skill covers a bounded workflow and links to nearby references or scripts for API details, command construction, data formats, validation checks, and recovery procedures. The split is determined by likely future agent tasks rather than source directory names alone.

每个存储库图都是独立的。当未来的代理需要示例、帮助者或验证者时，Each repository graph is self-contained. When a future agent needs an example, helper, or validator,迪斯科DisCo将其捆绑为参考或技能拥有的脚本，而不是要求代理重新打开原始存储库签出。每个图表还包含公共出处，包括源提交或等效标识符、可用的包版本、脏状态和相关证据路径。紧凑的路由元数据文件仅记录规范存储库身份、技能标识符、分类哈希、路由状态和确切分配。完整的分类原理和支持证据保留在运行时图之外的构造工件中。bundles it as a reference or skill-owned script rather than requiring the agent to reopen the original repository checkout. Every graph also contains public provenance, including the source commit or equivalent identifier, package version when available, dirty state, and relative evidence paths. A compact routing metadata file records only the canonical repository identity, skill identifier, taxonomy hash, routing status, and exact assignments. The full classification rationale and supporting evidence remain in construction artifacts outside the runtime graph.

验证将运行时技能与检查分开。Verification separates runtime skills from checks.

在接受存储库图之前，Before a repository graph is accepted,迪斯科DisCo对集成输入技能、组件技能、捆绑参考和捆绑脚本运行验证工作流。验证者创建断言支持的可用性案例，根据已确认的证据边界审查内容，并选择安全的本机示例、测试、CLI 检查、小型设备检查或烟雾脚本（如果可用）。本机检查分类为runs a verification workflow over the integrated entry skill, component skills, bundled references, and bundled scripts. The verifier creates assertion-backed usability cases, reviews content against the confirmed evidence boundary, and selects safe native examples, tests, CLI checks, tiny-fixture checks, or smoke scripts when available. Native checks are classified as通过pass, 技能差距skill_gap, 本机失败native_fail, 跳过不安全skip_unsafe, 或, or跳过未选择skip_not_selected。技能差距会触发对负责的技能、参考、脚本或路线的本地化修复，然后重新运行相关检查。. A skill gap triggers a localized repair to the responsible skill, reference, script, or route, after which the relevant checks are rerun.

静态门检查元数据、链接完整性、自我包含、出处、路由元数据、本地路径泄漏以及运行时文件和仅构建工件之间的分离。运行时文件仅限于技能图本身，例如Static gates check metadata, link integrity, self-containment, provenance, routing metadata, local-path leakage, and the separation between runtime files and construction-only artifacts. Runtime files are limited to the skill graph itself, such as技能.mdSKILL.md, 参考文献/references/, 脚本/scripts/，以及可选的, and optional子技能/sub-skills/。验证报告和其他仅检查文件写入运行时图之外。. Verification reports and other check-only files are written outside the runtime graph.

分类归纳在分配之前构建路由树。Taxonomy induction builds the routing tree before assignment.

存储库分类法构建是一个基于短存储库摘要记录的独立 Python 管道。输入标准化接受存储库标识符和短存储库摘要，拒绝重复的存储库 ID 和空摘要，对库存进行稳定排序，记录 SHA-256 哈希值，并写入不可变的标准化 JSONL 文件。仅存储库标识符和简短的存储库摘要会发送到模型。 URL、星号、字数以及任何预先存在的区域或系列字段都保留为审核元数据，但从模型输入中排除，因此树反映了功能语义而不是流行度或继承的标签。Repository taxonomy construction is a separate Python pipeline over short repository summary records. Input normalization accepts repository identifiers and short repository summaries, rejects duplicate repository IDs and empty summaries, stable-sorts the inventory, records SHA-256 hashes, and writes an immutable normalized JSONL file. Only the repository identifier and short repository summary are sent to the model. URLs, stars, word counts, and any pre-existing area or family fields are retained as audit metadata but excluded from model input, so the tree reflects capability semantics rather than popularity or inherited labels.

该管道首先要求法学硕士提出一个完整的区域和系列两级树，然后将 1,000 个存储库分成 100 个稳定批次，每批 10 个存储库。每个批次由两个单独的模型调用处理。定位器临时将每个存储库分配到精确的、可接受的、较差的或不适合的区域到家庭路径，以进行压力测试覆盖范围。然后，独立法官会审查当前树是否捕获了该批次中的功能差异，识别结构问题，例如缺失功能、重叠系列、混合轴、模糊范围、超载节点和包罗万象的类别。这些临时分配仅用于诊断，不会作为最终路由器分配发布。The pipeline first asks an LLM to propose a complete two-level tree of areas and families, then splits the 1,000 repositories into 100 stable batches of 10 repositories. Each batch is processed by two separate model calls. A locator provisionally assigns every repository to an exact, acceptable, poor, or no-fit area-to-family path to stress-test coverage. An independent judge then reviews whether the current tree captures the capability distinctions in that batch, identifying structural issues such as missing capabilities, overlapping families, mixed axes, ambiguous scopes, overloaded nodes, and catch-all categories. These provisional assignments are used only for diagnosis and are not published as final router assignments.

所有批次完成后，聚合器将综合 100 条评判评论以及确定性统计数据。这些统计数据包括准确率、可接受率、不良率和不适合率、每个家庭的临时负荷、对小家庭审查的有效支持、未使用和超负荷的家庭以及异常证据。修订者通过编写完整的修订树来应用批准的综合。在下一轮评估开始之前，工作流程会验证修订后的架构和树差异，包括键入的添加、删除、重命名、合并、拆分和范围重写效果。默认收敛门需要至少两轮评估、完整批次覆盖、有界不适合和不良适合率、有界小系列和未使用系列率、无阻塞问题、无重大变更判断批次、无超载系列、无未解决的修订指令以及来自聚合器的明确停止建议。运行会写入最终的分类 JSON、渲染的 Markdown 树、运行摘要和最终异常值记录。它不写入最终的存储库分配。After all batches finish, an aggregator synthesizes the 100 judge reviews together with deterministic statistics. These statistics include exact, acceptable, poor, and no-fit rates, per-family provisional load, effective support for small-family review, unused and overloaded families, and outlier evidence. A reviser applies the approved synthesis by writing a complete revised tree. Before the next evaluation round begins, the workflow validates the revised schema and tree diff, including typed add, remove, rename, merge, split, and scope-rewrite effects. The default convergence gate requires at least two evaluation rounds, full batch coverage, bounded no-fit and poor-fit rates, bounded small-family and unused-family rates, no blocker issues, no major-change judge batches, no overloaded families, no unresolved revision directives, and an explicit stop recommendation from the aggregator. The run writes the final taxonomy JSON, a rendered Markdown tree, a run summary, and final outlier records. It does not write final repository assignments.

分类与技能生成是分开的。Classification is separate from skill generation.

当图表通过验证后，After a graph passes verification,迪斯科DisCo根据区域和家庭的固定分类法对原始存储库进行分类。存储库签出是主要证据来源，而生成的图表仅用于导航。每项作业都需要特定于作业的理由、置信度和非生成的存储库证据。仅关键字、仅依赖项、可选集成和仅示例匹配将被拒绝。当存储库公开多个不同的功能时，它可能会收到多个分配。如果不支持确切的族，则该图将被记录为未分类，而不是被迫进入弱路线。classifies the original repository against the fixed taxonomy of areas and families. The repository checkout is the primary evidence source, while the generated graph is used only for navigation. Every assignment requires an assignment-specific rationale, confidence, and non-generated repository evidence. Keyword-only, dependency-only, optional-integration, and example-only matches are rejected. A repository may receive several assignments when it exposes several distinct capabilities. If no exact family is supported, the graph is recorded as unclassified rather than being forced into a weak route.

库路由器通过渐进公开来公开图。The library router exposes the graph through progressive disclosure.

经过验证、分类和批准后，存储库图被导入到托管存储库技能集合中，并根据中央存储库和分配索引重建同级路由器。当前的公共集合包含 1,000 个存储库图条目，位于After verification, classification, and approval, the repository graph is imported into the managed repository-skill collection, and the sibling router is rebuilt from the central repository and assignment indexes. The current public collection contains 1,000 repository graph entries under技能/存储库/repo-skills/skills/repositories/repo-skills/，连同模型可见, together with a model-visible技能/存储库/repo-skills-router/skills/repositories/repo-skills-router/。存储库条目和组件技能是面向代理的技能，但它们从初始模型可见技能列表中被省略并通过路由器访问。在研究过程中，研究员模式将请求范围从区域缩小到家庭，打开相关的存储库图，并仅加载操作上下文所需的技能、参考资料或脚本. The repository entry and component skills are agent-facing skills, but they are omitted from the initial model-visible skill list and accessed through the router. During research, researcher mode narrows the request from area to family, opens the relevant repository graph, and loads only the skills, references, or scripts needed as operating context𝒦\mathcal{K}。完整的库永远不会放入上下文中，下游代理仅接收为当前 ML 研究任务选择的存储库操作知识。. The full library is never placed into context, and the downstream agent receives only the repository operational knowledge selected for the current ML research task.

A.2 纸质衍生和任务导向的技能构建Paper-Derived and Task-Oriented Skill Construction

除了公共存储库集合之外，我们还应用Beyond the public repository collection, we apply迪斯科DisCo第 4 节中的四项自主研究评估to the four autonomous-research evaluations in Section5。 PaperBench 使用源锚定的纸张技能，并为每个目标再现选择下游技能库。其他三个设置使用面向任务的蒸馏。 MLE-bench 为每个竞赛构建一个图，而 FrontierCS 和 PassNet 分别为基准构建一个图。在所有四种设置中，技能构建都是在下游评估之前完成的，并且报告的有技能和无技能条件使骨干、工具和运行预算保持固定。. PaperBench uses source-anchored paper skills, with the downstream skill pool selected for each target reproduction. The other three settings use task-oriented distillation. MLE-bench constructs one graph per competition, whereas FrontierCS and PassNet each construct a single graph for the benchmark. In all four settings, skill construction is completed before downstream evaluation, and the reported with- and without-skills conditions keep the backbone, harness, and running budget fixed.

A.2.1 MLE 工作台MLE-bench

对于 MLE-bench，我们运行面向任务的蒸馏（For MLE-bench, we run task-oriented distillation (Section 3.2）每个任务一次，并将这一一次性技能构建与下游基准测试执行分开。锚点是比赛本身，) once per task and separate this one-time skill construction from downstream benchmark execution. The anchor is the competition itself,z=τz=\tau。范围界定将其分解为解决方案所需的功能，基础通过网络搜索收集与任务相关的资源，构建组装任务级技能图，验证使用来自诊断试验的执行反馈，所有这些都在有限的构建预算下的工作空间内进行。在运行阶段，图表被冻结，我们衡量它是否有助于 Codex 在单独的、匹配的执行预算下解决任务。. Scoping decomposes it into the capabilities required by a solution, grounding gathers task-relevant resources through web search, construction assembles a task-level skill graph, and verification uses execution feedback from diagnostic trials, all within a workspace under a bounded construction budget. During the running phase, the graph is frozen and we measure whether it helps Codex solve the task under a separate, matched execution budget.Table 5总结了两个阶段。summarizes the two phases.

范围界定和基础始于研究计划。Scoping and grounding begin with a research plan.

范围界定和基础阶段共同产生一个有证据支持的计划。每次探索迭代都在代码执行之前开始，并具有明确的研究计划步骤。根据对任务的初步诊断，该模型会分解问题并确定富有成效的试验所需的操作知识。例如，该计划可能会询问哪种预训练模型最适合继续训练或微调，应如何预处理数据，或者某个专门领域是否需要咨询相关工作。然后它指导网络搜索和来源收集，收集证据The scoping and grounding stages together produce an evidence-backed plan. Each exploration iteration begins before code execution with an explicit research-planning step. Based on its initial diagnosis of the task, the model decomposes the problem and identifies the operational knowledge needed for a productive trial. The plan may ask, for example, which pretrained model is most appropriate for continued training or fine-tuning, how the data should be preprocessed, or whether a specialized domain requires consulting related work. It then guides web search and source collection, assembling the evidence𝒳\mathcal{X}为了任务。为了防止任务直接泄露，我们屏蔽了该任务的原始竞赛网页，并排除了与该基准任务相关的竞赛特定内容。在构建过程中，收集到的证据被综合成一种以执行为导向的技能，描述建议的决策、程序和检查。 Codex读取该技能，编写相应的代码，并执行审判。for the task. To prevent direct task leakage, we block the task’s original competition webpage and exclude competition-specific content associated with that benchmark task. During construction, the collected evidence is synthesized into an execution-oriented skill that describes the recommended decisions, procedures, and checks. Codex reads this skill, writes the corresponding code, and executes the trial.

执行反馈驱动验证。Execution feedback drives verification.

细化循环使用执行反馈作为验证信号来实现验证阶段。每次试验后，Codex 都会检查执行日志和观察结果，总结运行情况，并分析哪些决策有用或有限制。然后它决定是否应该改进当前技能。当需要细化时，下一个研究-计划-细化步骤会收到三种形式的上下文：The refinement loop implements the verification stage, using execution feedback as the verification signal. After each trial, Codex inspects the execution logs and observed results, summarizes the run, and analyzes which decisions were useful or limiting. It then decides whether the current skill should be refined. When refinement is needed, the next research-plan-refine step receives exactly three forms of context:

ℱt+1=(St,Summary⁡(Lt),Analysis⁡(Rt)),\mathcal{F}_{t+1}=\bigl(S_{t},\;\operatorname{Summary}(L_{t}),\;\operatorname{Analysis}(R_{t})\bigr), (9)

哪里whereStS_{t}是之前的技能，is the previous skill,LtL_{t}是执行日志，并且is the execution log, andRtR_{t}是迭代时观察到的结果is the observed result at iterationtt。该模型使用此上下文来修改研究计划，在必要时收集额外的证据，并生成下一个技能版本。然后，修改后的技能将通过 Codex 编写和执行的另一项试验进行评估。这个循环一直持续到勘探预算用完或者模型确定进一步的细化不太可能产生成效。. The model uses this context to revise the research plan, collect additional evidence when necessary, and produce the next skill version. The revised skill is then evaluated through another trial written and executed by Codex. This loop continues until the exploration budget is exhausted or the model determines that further refinement is unlikely to be productive.

探索可以优化学习进度，而不是获得奖牌。Exploration optimizes learning progress, not medal attainment.

构建阶段并不要求 Codex 达到奖牌级别的分数。获得奖牌可能需要长期、完全优化的训练，而探索的目的是在预算允许的情况下测试尽可能多的合理建模和实施方向。因此，我们赞成快速诊断迭代。当迭代产生有用的改进时，方向就会继续。否则，模型可以修改计划或转向另一个方向。该标准使用 24 个 GPU 小时来积累广泛有用的操作知识，而不是花费大部分构建预算来完成单个提交。The construction phase does not require Codex to reach a medal-level score. Medal attainment may require a long, fully optimized training run, whereas the purpose of exploration is to test as many plausible modeling and implementation directions as the budget allows. We therefore favor rapid diagnostic iterations. A direction is continued when an iteration produces a useful improvement. Otherwise, the model can revise the plan or move to another direction. This criterion uses the 24 GPU-hours to accumulate broadly useful operational knowledge rather than spending most of the construction budget on completing a single submission.

最终技能是描述性的而不是可执行的。Final skills are descriptive rather than executable.

At the end of exploration, the task’s operational-knowledge skill graph is finalized as descriptive guidance only. Its skills may record task diagnoses, model and preprocessing choices, training strategies, expected observations, and checks, but contain no runnable training or inference scripts. Codex must generate and execute the task implementation from this guidance during each benchmark run. This design prevents the running phase from replaying a fixed solution script and preserves run-to-run stochasticity in agent decisions and implementation. Because each task yields a small graph of largely independent skills, the link set ℒ\mathcal{L} remains light, and routing is handled by the library-level entry point rather than a deep per-task hierarchy.

Benchmark running uses autonomous skill selection.

In the running phase, the finalized task skill graph is made available to Codex. We do not prescribe a fixed task-to-skill mapping. Following progressive disclosure, Codex decides which skills are relevant for each task, writes the implementation, and runs the resulting solution. Unlike exploration, this phase uses its full budget to train, iterate, and optimize the benchmark target. Each task receives at most 24 GPU-hours. The no-skill condition uses the same Codex backbone and running budget but does not receive the distilled skills. The reported comparison isolates the downstream effect of access to the finalized operational knowledge under matched running budgets. The separate exploration budget is the one-time cost of constructing that knowledge.

A.2.2 PaperBench

For PaperBench, the unit of reusable knowledge is a source paper rather than the downstream reproduction target. DisCo distills each selected prior paper into module-level skills and then assembles a pool of these skills for a target paper. These source skills are task-agnostic with respect to future use, although the pool exposed in a PaperBench run is conditioned on the target paper’s related-work context. Skill construction remains strictly separated from benchmark running.

Target-conditioned source collection.

For each target paper τ\tau, we analyze its related work and methodology to identify prior studies that address closely related research problems. We select up to 10 representative papers from the related-work section and collect their open-source repositories when available. The target paper itself and its released code or artifacts are excluded as skill sources. The selected prior papers provide the methodological specification, while their repositories may provide implementation evidence for data processing, model components, training, inference, and evaluation.

Source-anchored module skills.

Each selected source paper is decomposed into a small set of functionally bounded modules rather than summarized as a single skill. A module skill states the reusable capability, its inputs and outputs, applicable conditions, dependencies, configuration, procedure, and validation contract. Supporting scripts or references are included when needed to make the module executable or self-contained. The boundaries follow the paper’s reusable method and experimental components rather than the directory structure of an accompanying implementation. In the current protocol, each selected source contributes 3–5 representative module skills.

Verification through isolated tests and recovery.

Every module skill receives an assertion-backed test or smoke check. After the modules pass in isolation, DisCo evaluates whether their composition can recover a bounded result or mechanism from the source paper. The recovery stage may use the paper, generated module documents and skills, and approved datasets or runtime resources, but it does not read the original implementation repository. This source boundary tests whether the generated skills carry the operational knowledge rather than merely pointing back to the source code. Recovery failures are analyzed at the module level and trigger focused revisions to interfaces, procedures, configuration, dependencies, or evaluation logic.

PaperBench pool and downstream running.

经过验证后，每篇目标论文都会收到一个由其选定的相关工作来源的经过验证的技能组成的池。研究代理在复制过程中自主地从该池中选择和组合技能。目标条件选择使池与当前问题相关，而源锚定使每个组成技能在目标之外可重用。无技能条件使用相同的主干、工具和运行预算，而无需访问构建的池，因此报告的比较衡量的是纸质操作环境的下游影响，而不是重播固定的目标解决方案。After verification, each target paper receives a pool assembled from the validated skills of its selected related-work sources. The research agent autonomously selects and composes skills from this pool during reproduction. The target-conditioned selection keeps the pool relevant to the current problem, while source anchoring keeps each constituent skill reusable beyond that target. The no-skill condition uses the same backbone, harness, and running budget without access to the constructed pool, so the reported comparison measures the downstream effect of the paper-derived operating context rather than replaying a fixed target solution.

A.2.3 前沿CSFrontierCS

FrontierCS 将蒸馏锚定在整个基准上，而不是单个任务上。这与用于 MLE-bench 的每场比赛图表和为 PaperBench 组装的每目标源技能池不同。我们构建了一个在 Agent Track 中共享的单一面向恢复的技能图，涵盖精确解决方案、启发式、交互式和在线设置。在整个构建过程中，我们从各个问题、解决方案片段、实现、任务标识符和调整常量中排除文本。构建和细化在评估之前完成，之后所有报告的运行的图表都被冻结。FrontierCS anchors distillation on the benchmark as a whole rather than on individual tasks. This differs from the per-competition graphs used for MLE-bench and the per-target source-skill pools assembled for PaperBench. We build a single recovery-oriented skill graph shared across the Agent Track, covering exact-solution, heuristic, interactive, and online settings. Throughout construction, we exclude text from individual problems, solution fragments, implementations, task identifiers, and tuned constants. Construction and refinement are completed before evaluation, after which the graph is frozen for all reported runs.

基础始于专家解决问题的指导。Grounding starts from expert problem-solving guidance.

最初的证据包括两个人类创作的来源。其中列出了常见的算法和数据结构及其适用条件和拒绝标准。另一个为启发式搜索提供量化指导，包括预算分配、表示、增量评估、邻域设计、优化器选择、校准和期限管理。我们通过根据原始工作区提示改编的问题解决指导来补充它们，强调阅读完整的合同，保留简单的正确回退，使用强力和随机差异测试，探测边界和资源限制，并将分级提交视为诊断反馈。The initial evidence comprises two human-authored sources. One catalogs common algorithms and data structures together with their applicability conditions and rejection criteria. The other provides quantified guidance for heuristic search, including budget allocation, representation, incremental evaluation, neighborhood design, optimizer selection, calibration, and deadline management. We supplement them with problem-solving guidance adapted from the original workspace prompt, emphasizing reading the full contract, preserving a simple correct fallback, using brute force and randomized differential testing, probing boundary and resource limits, and treating graded submissions as diagnostic feedback.

构建将恢复知识组织为路由图。Construction organizes recovery knowledge as a routed graph.

入门技能充当恢复路由器，仅在集中的初始尝试暴露出具体故障或使解决方案不完整后才被激活。它重建紧凑的恢复快照，识别最早涉及的层，并将代理路由到八个逐步公开的模块之一。这些模块涵盖建模和方法选择、实现、检查器和评估器构建、验证、交互式推理、反应式在线决策、testlib 判断和高原逃逸。对同一有序对的重复引用折叠后，入门技能和模块形成共享技能图The entry skill acts as a recovery router and is activated only after a focused initial attempt exposes a concrete failure or leaves the solution incomplete. It reconstructs a compact recovery snapshot, identifies the earliest implicated layer, and routes the agent to one of eight progressively disclosed modules. These modules cover modeling and method selection, implementation, checker and evaluator construction, validation, interactive inference, reactive online decisions, testlib judging, and plateau escape. After repeated references to the same ordered pair are collapsed, the entry skill and modules form the shared skill graph𝒢\mathcal{G}有 9 个节点和 42 个不同的有向链接。在整个图表中，代理区分了保证有效的with nine nodes and 42 distinct directed links. Across the graph, the agent distinguishes a guaranteed-valid后备fallback, 最好的验证, the best-validated冠军champion，以及实验性的, and experimental挑战者challengers。较弱或无效的挑战者无法取代冠军。. A weaker or invalid challenger cannot replace the champion.

配对试验推动迭代验证。Paired trials drive iterative verification.

对于选定的开发问题，每个候选图都通过匹配的代理试验进行评估。在精炼轮On selected development problems, each candidate graph is evaluated through matched agent trials. At refinement roundtt，使用当前图运行, runs using the current graph𝒢(t)\mathcal{G}^{(t)}与固定的无技能基线进行比较并使用之前的版本运行are compared with both a fixed no-skill baseline and runs using the preceding version𝒢(t−1)\mathcal{G}^{(t-1)}，在相同的主干、线束、任务接口和评分端点下。前者衡量图表的累积效果，而后者则隔离最新修订的效果。我们检查分数变化以及配对轨迹，包括所选的公式和方法、数据结构、本地测试、提交、经过净化的反馈和最终工件。修复仅限于涉及的节点或链接，并且仅当后续试验重现预期的行为变化或提供独立证据证明修订后的指南纠正了诊断的故障时才保留修订；否则，将其从冻结图中排除。, under the same backbone, harness, task interface, and scoring endpoint. The former measures the accumulated effect of the graph, while the latter isolates the effect of the latest revision. We inspect score changes together with the paired trajectories, including the chosen formulation and method, data structures, local tests, submissions, sanitized feedback, and final artifact. Repairs are localized to the implicated nodes or links, and a revision is retained only when follow-up trials reproduce the intended behavioral change or provide independent evidence that the revised guidance corrects the diagnosed failure; otherwise, it is excluded from the frozen graph.

细化保留了循环机制。Refinement retains recurrent mechanisms.

正面案例反复保留了法律冠军，改变了所涉及的问题表述或搜索结构，并比较了实质上不同的挑战者。负面案例暴露了不必要的评估器构建、在一个方法族内的重复调整以及过早的委托。在量化标准和独立批评的指导下，我们仅保留对激活时间、故障层路由、评估者证据门、冠军保存和高原逃逸的经常性、因果支持的修订。这些修订共同将最初的整体工作流程转变为最终的路由图。Positive cases repeatedly preserved a legal champion, changed the implicated problem formulation or search structure, and compared materially different challengers. Negative cases exposed unnecessary evaluator construction, repeated tuning within one method family, and premature delegation. We retain only recurrent, causally supported revisions to activation timing, failure-layer routing, evaluator evidence gates, champion preservation, and plateau escape, guided by quantified criteria and independent critique. Together, these revisions transformed the initial monolithic workflow into the final routed graph.

A.2.4 通行网PassNet

PassNet 使用面向任务的蒸馏。每个基准实例都被视为任务锚点PassNet uses task-oriented distillation. Each benchmark instance is treated as a task anchorz=τz=\tau：运行首先确定实例需要什么，然后识别当前代理无法可靠提供的功能，从任务执行和评估者反馈中收集证据，并将有用的过程提炼成技能图。分析是在单个任务实例的级别上执行的，而在修改共享图时会汇集来自多个实例的证据。我们在整个施工过程中保持主干和安全带固定。: the run first determines what the instance requires, then identifies capabilities that the current agent does not reliably provide, gathers evidence from task executions and evaluator feedback, and distills useful procedures into a skill graph. The analyses are performed at the level of individual task instances, while evidence from multiple instances is pooled when revising the shared graph. We keep the backbone and harness fixed throughout construction.

能力范围和候选人基础。Capability scoping and candidate grounding.

对于 PassNet 实例，相关功能可以包括检查 FX 图、确定模式是否可能匹配、选择可能从融合中受益的区域、编写 Triton 替换、验证语义等价性以及解释评估器或匹配失败。我们通过初步尝试来确定代理已经可以使用哪些功能以及哪些差距阻碍了有用的优化。在收集任务轨迹之前，我们根据代理的现有知识提供临时候选程序。这些程序被视为关于有用操作知识的假设，而不是公认的技能。然后，我们在匹配条件下（无论有或没有这些程序）在 50 个训练集实例上运行代理，并使用生成的配对轨迹来修改候选对象并组装 PassNet 技能图的第一个版本。For a PassNet instance, the relevant capabilities can include inspecting an FX graph, determining whether a pattern is likely to match, selecting regions that may benefit from fusion, writing a Triton replacement, validating semantic equivalence, and interpreting evaluator or match failures. We use an initial attempt to determine which capabilities are already available to the agent and which gaps prevent a useful optimization. Before collecting task trajectories, we provide provisional candidate procedures based on the agent’s existing knowledge. These procedures are treated as hypotheses about useful operational knowledge rather than accepted skills. We then run the agent on 50 training-set instances under matched conditions, with and without these procedures, and use the resulting paired trajectories to revise the candidates and assemble the first version of the PassNet skill graph.

对训练集进行放大细化。Scale-up refinement over the training set.

PassNet 训练分割包含超过 4k 个实例。完全解决所有这些问题将需要 20 多天的时间，并且会产生大量的 API 成本，因此我们使用筛选和调度工作流程来搜索可能揭示有用的优化或故障模式的其他任务实例。 CPU pass 首先使用轻量级启发式方法选择经过筛选的候选者，以实现对急切执行的潜在改进。我们对筛选出的候选者进行抽样检查，将其分批分配给子代理，并要求子代理总结在其轨迹中观察到的重复出现的优化模式和故障模式。我们使用这些摘要以及基本任务结果作为修改技能图的额外证据。训练集的一次传递大约需要一天的时间，并且支持第二个图形版本。The PassNet training split contains more than 4k instances. Solving all of them in full would take more than 20 days and incur substantial API cost, so we use a screening-and-dispatch workflow to search for additional task instances that may reveal useful optimization or failure patterns. A CPU pass first selects screened candidates using a lightweight heuristic for potential improvement over eager execution. We sample-check the screened candidates, dispatch them to sub-agents in batches, and ask the sub-agents to summarize recurring optimization patterns and failure modes observed in their trajectories. We use these summaries, together with the underlying task outcomes, as additional evidence for revising the skill graph. One pass over the training set takes approximately one day and supports the second graph version.

配对验证和故障驱动的细化。Paired verification and failure-driven refinement.

我们使用相同的主干、线束、任务接口和评分端点来评估相同采样任务的每个图修订版。我们将无技能基线与每个图形版本进行比较，并检查配对轨迹以及聚合指标。表We evaluate each graph revision on the same sampled tasks with the same backbone, harness, task interface, and scoring endpoint. We compare the no-skill baseline with each graph version and inspect the paired trajectories alongside the aggregate metrics. Table6显示在两个图形修订版中，几何平均值从无技能基线的 0.5352 增加到第二版本图形的 0.6941，中位数从 0.7340 增加到 0.7941，匹配失败从 10/50 减少到 1/50，平均解决时间从 40 分钟减少到 22 分钟。算术平均值对该样本中的异常值更加敏感：两个实例在一次无技能运行中获得异常大的分数 10.63 和 8.18，但在另一次重复运行中分别获得 0.99 和 0.10。由于这些异常值无法可靠地再现，因此我们检查了相应的技能配备轨迹。此错误分析发现了过于保守的规则，而不是缺少实施模板。该技能警告代理不要使用自定义内核重新实现供应商优化的重型运算符，例如大型密集矩阵乘法或卷积。在许多情况下，这是一个有用的默认值，但它阻止了shows that across the two graph revisions, the geometric mean increases from 0.5352 for the no-skill baseline to 0.6941 for the second-version graph, the median increases from 0.7340 to 0.7941, match failures decrease from 10/50 to 1/50, and average solve time decreases from 40 minutes to 22 minutes. The arithmetic mean is more sensitive to outliers in this sample: two instances receive unusually large scores, 10.63 and 8.18, in one no-skill run, but score 0.99 and 0.10, respectively, in another repeated run. Because these outliers were not reproduced reliably, we examined the corresponding skill-equipped trajectories. This error analysis identified an overly conservative rule rather than a missing implementation template. The skill warned the agent against reimplementing vendor-optimized heavy operators, such as large dense matrix multiplications or convolutions, with custom kernels. This is a useful default in many cases, but it blocked a转换3dconv3d案例与case with步幅 == 内核大小stride == kernel_size。在这种情况下，计算可以减少为元素乘法，而通用 cuDNN 路径仍可能产生与重叠卷积相关的布局和收集开销。轨迹表明，智能体认识到了这种可能性，但放弃了重写，因为警告表达得太绝对了。该案件在最初的样本和随后的筛选中均不存在，因此早期的证据并未暴露过于宽泛的规则。我们修改了该技能，将警告视为可撤销的优先事项，而不是绝对禁止：通常应保留供应商实现，但图形结构和评估者证据可能会证明例外是合理的。. In this regime, the computation can reduce to elementwise multiplication, while the generic cuDNN path may still incur layout and gather overhead associated with overlapping convolution. The trajectory showed that the agent recognized this possibility but abandoned the rewrite because the warning was expressed too absolutely. The case was absent from both the initial sample and the subsequent screening pass, so the earlier evidence did not expose the overly broad rule. We revised the skill to treat the warning as a defeasible prior rather than an absolute ban: vendor implementations should normally be preserved, but graph structure and evaluator evidence may justify an exception.
